summary: A 29-year-old skier broke his leg on the Miniturn Mile, a popular out-of-bounds side-country run from Vail Resort toward Minturn; his 911 call came at ~3 p.m. Thursday. Vail Mountain Rescue and the Eagle County Sheriff's Office reached him about an hour later; Care Flight could not find a safe landing zone, so ~12 VMRG members sledded him out to a road and he was flown to Vail Valley Medical Center ~7 p.m. Vail Ski Patrol assisted.
location: Miniturn Mile (Vail Resort side-country, toward Minturn)
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group; Eagle County Sheriff's Office; Care Flight; Vail Ski Patrol
notes: Date inferred: syndicated denverchannel.com story (Copyright 2012) describes a Thursday-afternoon rescue; 2012-01-12 = Thursday.
